title: Committed snapshots pin the installed code profile
decision:
- P13 commits `openapi.json`, `operations.json`, `errors.json` and digest manifest
  per major. `webhooks.json` is added by P14, not as an empty placeholder.
- Snapshots describe installed code declarations, not tenant activation or effective
  permissions. `operations.json` is behavioral authority; OpenAPI is HTTP projection.
- A stdlib PHP gate rejects removals/tightening and pagination/error reinterpretation;
  allowed optional additions pass. Each rule has a planted red fixture.
- Generator and gate add no runtime dependency and exclude timestamps, host paths,
  activation epochs and secrets.
rationale:
Tenant-specific snapshots are non-reproducible and leak availability. OpenAPI alone
cannot encode idempotency, authorization layers or cursor compatibility.

  allowed optional additions pass. Each rule has a planted red fixture.
- Generator and gate add no runtime dependency and exclude timestamps, host paths,

sections.title: Почему
sections.text:
Tenant-specific snapshots are non-reproducible and leak availability. OpenAPI alone
cannot encode idempotency, authorization layers or cursor compatibility.

sections.title: Consequences
sections.text:
P13.10 generates and commits the v1 baseline; P13.11 installs the gate. P14 extends
the same manifest with webhooks without changing P13 semantics.
